The '''44th Special Operations Division''' was a [[Division/Legends|unit]] of [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] within the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]]. It participated in the [[Battle of Khorm/Legends|Battle of Khorm]]. One notable unit of the 44th Special Operations Division was the [[Devil Dogs]].
